tutorial.rictus.phase1-00:
Welcome to your new base. While Cavalier is recovering, you can continue operations from here.

Your goal is to eliminate targets responsible for the destruction of Solo Nobre, and to destabilize the local ruling powers on Mar Nosso.
tutorial.rictus.phase1-01: You are starting with nothing and will need to build up an arsenal. Society is breaking down across the planet. The chaos has created opportunities to salvage what you need for your work.
tutorial.rictus.phase1-02: As you make progress, you will find more and more advanced weaponry and supplies, and unlock new bases.
tutorial.rictus.phase1-03: I have selected a salvage opportunity for you. Use the Mission Selector to pick the mission and head out. Grab what you can and return. If you spend too much time, expect reinforcements to arrive.
tutorial.rictus.phase1-04: While you are out, I will be making some helpful modifications to this base.
tutorial.rictus.phase1-idle: Use the Mission Selector to access the Salvage mission. Remember to EXAMINE items in your inventory to learn more about them. I will tell you more when you return.
tutorial.rictus.phase2-00:
You made it back. Hopefully you picked up some useful equipment.

I have added a new feature to your base, the FABRICATOR. It is next to your ARMORY.
tutorial.rictus.phase2-01:
You may store and retrieve inventory from the ARMORY. Your ARMORY is shared between all bases.

You may use the FABRICATOR to build inventory from raw parts.
tutorial.rictus.phase2-02:
Your options will expand as you make more progress.

You do not have a way to build and store vehicles yet. Don’t give up hope though…
tutorial.rictus.phase2-03: Now that you have completed a Salvage mission, I have updated your Mission Selector with new missions. These missions have specific objectives. You can complete these with equipment from Crow’s Field. When these missions are complete, I will have more for you.
tutorial.rictus.phase2-idle:
You have two new missions in your Mission Selector to complete.

You may continue to salvage materials from the Crow’s Field. Store anything you are not bringing on a mission in your ARMORY.
tutorial.rictus.phase3-00:
Congratulations, you have completed the first tier of missions. You are one step closer to total victory.

You are ready for the next tier.
tutorial.rictus.phase3-01: A new Salvage mission is available. It offers new equipment and new challenges.
tutorial.rictus.phase3-02: Once you have completed this Salvage mission, new objective missions will be unlocked. When those are complete, a new Salvage mission will unlock, and so on and so forth.
tutorial.rictus.phase3-02b: Always watch your back. Enemies will be alerted by your actions and reinforcements will try to catch you unaware.
tutorial.rictus.phase3-03: Keep at it. I will monitor your progress with great interest. But for now, I have a pressing engagement elsewhere.
tutorial.rictus.phase4-00: It is time to take your insurgency to the next level. You may now store, build, and modify vehicles for your arsenal. A new FABRICATOR is available which can assemble vehicles.
tutorial.rictus.phase4-01: You will store vehicles here by parking them on a GANTRY PAD. Each pad stores one vehicle.
tutorial.rictus.phase4-02: You may deconstruct vehicles on the pad for parts. This base only has room for one GANTRY PAD.
tutorial.rictus.phase4-03: You will need a vehicle in the future. Build or secure one as you continue your missions.
tutorial.rictus.phase4-idle: You will need a vehicle in the future. Build or secure one as you continue your missions.
tutorial.rictus.phase5-00:
Welcome back.

The work ahead will be more challenging. This base is too small for your needs. I have found a new location for you, the Garage.
tutorial.rictus.phase5-01: You will access new missions in the Garage. If you wish to retry any of the missions you have completed so far, you will need to return to Angel Base. The inventory in your ARMORY is shared between bases.
tutorial.rictus.phase5-02:
The Garage is across town. Travel is never safe, so you will need a vehicle.

Access the newest mission in the Mission Selector to make the trip.
tutorial.rictus.phase5-idle: Access the Causeway in the Mission Selector to get to your new Garage base. You will need a vehicle to make the trip.
tutorial.rictus.phase6-00: Welcome to your new base. The Garage will let you access higher tiers of missions and more opportunities to capture vehicles in missions. You may return to Angel Base at any time by taking the Causeway.
tutorial.rictus.phase6-01: The Garage is connected to an underground ELEVATOR system. In some missions, you will find an ELEVATOR access point. You can use the ELEVATOR to retrieve a vehicle you have stored at the Garage…
tutorial.rictus.phase6-02:
… or you can use the ELEVATOR to send a vehicle from the mission to the Garage for storage.

When you use an ELEVATOR, you will not be able to use it again until you leave the mission.
tutorial.rictus.phase6-03:
Your first Salvage mission from the Garage has vehicles and an ELEVATOR.

I will have more information for you when you return.
tutorial.rictus.phase6-idle: When you are on a mission, you can send or retrieve vehicles using an ELEVATOR to or from one of your GANTRY PADS.
tutorial.rictus.phase7-00: If you want to add new GANTRY PADS to the Garage, construct a Gantry Pad Extension Kit in the FABRICATOR. Add that Gantry Pad Extension Kit to your Armory and your new GANTRY PAD will start to build.
tutorial.rictus.phase7-01: It will be ready to use after you leave and return to the Garage once.
tutorial.rictus.phase7-02: I cannot stay here any longer, but I have left you an assistant who should be of use. I wish you luck making the most of your campaign on Mar Nosso.
tutorial.rictus.darkbuddy-00:
Congratulations! You have completed all missions available in Early Access.

The war on Mar Nosso will continue. In the meantime, I suggest expanding your collection and trying new loadouts.
tutorial.buddy-00: Gee! Did you know you can use the SALVAGE MACHINE to break down vehicles? Just park them on the pad next to the SALVAGE MACHINE first. Remember, keep your hands away from moving blades!
tutorial.buddy-01: Gee! Did you know you can use the FABRICATOR to build new vehicles and upgrade existing ones? I bet you can make all kinds of crazy things!
tutorial.buddy-02: Gee! Did you know you get more GANTRY PADS by building a Gantry Pad Extension Kit in the FABRICATOR? Then put the Gantry Pad Extension Kit in your armory to start construction!
tutorial.buddy-03: Gee! Did you know some vehicles can mount weapons? Each GANTRY PAD has an ARMORY terminal to make it super easy to do it! What kind of combinations do you think work best?

undercity.hub.discussnames-00: Cavalier Oblique? Hell of a call sign.
undercity.hub.discussnames-01: Nom de guerre. My squad, we fought outside the wall. Joe, if he got one piece of intel on you, the psych ops never stopped. Tortured you all night long. Whisper rats in the jungle. All it took was a name.
undercity.hub.discussnames-02: So we did opsec Voltan style. My squad never gave their real names. Future Perfect, Local Maximum, Selector Reset.
undercity.hub.discussnames-03: CAVALIER's eyestalks tilt up at the hole briefly as he names the squadmates.
undercity.hub.discussnames-04: You know why the Voltans stopped using their real names? VMC denies it, but they had that one merc that escalated everything. Tunnel rat, saboteur. Assassin. With a .22 he killed—
undercity.hub.discussnames-05: —he killed the Shop Steward for 5'Ock and the Voltans said it was the beginning of the end. They were always insistent on the .22 part, but it was always a .45. I never understood that. Any more than them insisting that the name was—

undercity.m2.refugee-03: Not money. People. They took the sergeant. I told her, take me instead. What good am I gonna do? She told me shut the hell up.
undercity.m2.refugee-04: They'll come back soon. Kill them, you can have my chair.
undercity.m2.refugee-06: My son here will carry me. Or I'll die. But the Corvids will die first. They'll take no one else.
undercity.m2.cleared-00: Thank you, we are doing much better now.

joutsen_seaside.civ-02: Anyone can join the family. It doesn't matter where you're from, if you were rich or poor, what you did before you got here.
